pins.definition: Of the bright color of the sun or a ripe lemon.
Having the color of a ripe lemon or a sunflower.
Having the colour of gold, butter, or a ripe lemon.

situation: A fruit bowl sitting on a wooden counter in a brightly lit kitchen in the middle of the morning.
subject: the color yellow
brief: A single, perfectly ripe, vibrant yellow lemon sits at the very center of a ceramic bowl, glowing with an intense, saturated golden-yellow hue that stands out against the muted neutral tones of the kitchen. Every other piece of fruit in the bowl is a dull, pale green or brown, emphasizing the brilliance of the yellow skin of the lemon, which appears almost to radiate light.
